bandRule: Rank I is the affix's existing affixes.json range. Each later band starts one above the previous maximum and spans ceil(rankIMax / 2) values, so rank V tops out near 3x rank I. type_focus reproduces the specification's Fire Focus example. Values are placeholders until the balance pass.

uniques.name: Ashen Heart
uniques.benefit: Burns you inflict deal 50% more damage.

uniques.name: Last Breath
uniques.benefit: Once per battle, survive a lethal hit with 1 HP.
uniques.drawback: You receive half as much healing.

uniques.name: Creeping Venom
uniques.benefit: Poison you inflict grows 20% stronger each turn, up to +80%.
uniques.drawback: You take 20% more damage from Psychic moves.

uniques.name: Stormcaller
uniques.benefit: While weather is active, your moves of its matching type deal 30% more damage (Fire in sun, Water in rain).
uniques.drawback: With no weather active, your moves deal 15% less damage.

uniques.name: Rupture
uniques.benefit: Your physical moves always cause bleeding.
uniques.drawback: Bleed you cause is weaker per stack: 100%, 80%, 60%.

uniques.name: Titan's Heart
uniques.benefit: Your super-effective moves deal bonus damage equal to 10% of your max HP.
uniques.drawback: You cannot be healed in battle.

uniques.benefit: Item rewards you earn are 20% larger while it is in your party.
uniques.drawback: You take 25% more damage from moves.

uniques.name: Crescendo
uniques.benefit: Your moves deal 8% more for each full turn you have stayed in battle, up to 40%. Switching out resets it.
uniques.drawback: For your first two turns after entering, your moves deal 20% less.

uniques.name: Nightfang
uniques.benefit: Your damaging moves heal you 25% of the damage they deal.
uniques.drawback: You take 30% more damage from Fire and Fairy moves.

uniques.name: Iron Maiden
uniques.benefit: An enemy that hits you with a contact move loses 1/8 of its max HP.
uniques.drawback: Your own contact moves deal 20% less damage.

uniques.name: Tailwind Heart
uniques.drawback: Your Defense and Sp. Def are 15% lower.

uniques.name: Huntmark
uniques.benefit: Your first hit marks a foe; your later moves against it deal 25% more until it leaves the field.

uniques.name: Martyr's Gift
uniques.benefit: When you faint, the next ally to enter heals 50% of its max HP and gains +1 Attack and +1 Sp. Atk.
uniques.drawback: You take 15% more damage from moves.

uniques.name: Aegis Oath
uniques.benefit: You take 30% less damage from moves.

uniques.name: Fickle Fortune
uniques.benefit: Each turn a coin is flipped: heads, your moves deal 40% more that turn.
uniques.drawback: Tails: your moves deal 20% less that turn.
